name: dnbg
description: An opinionated software factory, packaged as a set of Claude Code plugins. AI-driven, human-directed, with built-in retrospectives that surface friction to fix. Honed over its first 7 months of real use across 35 repos, ~2k PRs, 1.2M+ lines of code, and 10 languages. Still sharpening.

plugins.name: dnbg-practices
plugins.description: Coding practices that apply on any host: design and clarity over expediency, security first, comment discipline, logging, and verifying what you don't know. No hooks, no forge.

plugins.name: dnbg-workflow
plugins.description: Opinionated GitHub workflow: worktree + draft PR flow, self-documenting issues, and an independent PR reviewer bot.

plugins.name: dnbg-work-summary
plugins.description: Turn your merged and open GitHub PRs into an audience-shaped recap — shipped work over a window, or what's in flight.

plugins.name: dnbg-agent-summaries
plugins.description: Keep the summary files agents write (research, design proposals, issue drafts) in one directory with a status field, and sweep the stale ones into an archive. No hooks, no forge.

plugins.name: dnbg-all
plugins.description: Everything: the workflow plugin, the coding practices, work summaries and agent summary files. Installs the other four.
